_rollupRules: A parent line = one invoice reference (Invoice #NNNN) with its total AMOUNT column value.
Sub-item detail lines ('--- <date> <description> = $X') belong to the preceding parent invoice line and MUST roll up: sum(subItems.amount) === parent.amount.

The statement_lines JSONB written to documents stores ONE line per parent invoice: {id, invoiceNumber, date, amount, status, source:'extracted'} — subItems are extraction detail, not separate statement lines.
Statement spans multiple pages; the aging table repeats per page — parse lines from all pages, dedupe the aging/total block.
Vendor comes from document letterhead content, never the email sender (this doc arrived as 'FW: Monthly Statement' from a NCG forwarder).
